opening.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create the opening keyframe for an ORIGINAL Chinese one-minute animated kitten comic titled The Missing Fish Biscuit. Two small anthropomorphic kitten friends standing at a low round kitchen table, both visible head to feet in the central upper two thirds with ample breathing room. Character A: orange tabby kitten with three darker orange forehead stripes, cream muzzle and belly, large amber eyes, a simple teal neckerchief, cheerful but puzzled, left of table. Character B: pale gray kitten with white muzzle, large green eyes, simple lavender neckerchief, calm thoughtful expression, right of table. Orange kitten points one paw at empty saucer; gray kitten looks toward orange kitten. Simple pastel mint kitchen walls, pale wooden floor, small window sunlight, no humans or other animals. Lower 20 percent relatively clear for later subtitles. A single cinematic animated scene, not a multi-panel page or character sheet. NO text, labels, speech bubbles, titles, watermark or logos. NO resemblance to copyrighted cat characters. Soft warm emotional comedy with very simple staging suitable for image-to-video animation.
